cd /workspace && OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission:/workspace/tests python3 - <<'EOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from protocol import validate
from te.session import run_case
import verify as V
# all edges withdrawn, admit mode, advanced step
case={"nodes":3,"edges":[[0,1,0]],"commodities":[],"workers":[[]],
      "quorum":1,"max_lag":0,"relax":[1,1],"rho":1,"mode":"admit",
      "events":[{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0},{"op":"deliver","id":1},{"op":"step"},{"op":"audit"}]}
req={"cases":[case]}; validate(req)
resp={"cases":[run_case(case)]}
print(json.dumps(resp["cases"][0]["events"][2]))
print("errors", V.verify(req,resp) or "none")
# commodity with zero slots
case2={"nodes":2,"edges":[[0,1,3]],"commodities":[{"source":0,"sink":1,"demand":5,"paths":[]}],
       "workers":[[0]],"quorum":1,"max_lag":1,"relax":[1,1],"rho":1,"mode":"route",
       "events":[{"op":"issue","id":1,"worker":0}]}
req2={"cases":[case2]}; validate(req2)
resp2={"cases":[run_case(case2)]}
print(json.dumps(resp2["cases"][0]["events"][0]))
print("errors", V.verify(req2,resp2) or "none")
# admit with zero slots and positive demand
case3=dict(case2); case3["mode"]="admit"
req3={"cases":[case3]}
resp3={"cases":[run_case(case3)]}
print(json.dumps(resp3["cases"][0]["events"][0]))
print("errors", V.verify(req3,resp3) or "none")
EOF
